u0: No switch toggle has occurred yet. The active objective is to locate the wall switch, move to the adjacent floor cell, face the switch, and execute the toggle action. A successful toggle produces switch_toggled, grants reward 1, and moves the agent to u1; until then, remain in u0.
u1: The switch has been toggled at least once, so the task is complete and reward has already been granted. This is the terminal success state: no further switch interaction is required, and the agent remains in u1 regardless of later events or actions.
